# ABRA

> An AI for competitive Pokémon, trained on real ladder battles. It calculates damage, reads what the opponent is likely hiding, and estimates who is winning mid-battle.

ABRA (Automated Battle Replay Analyzer) builds a player for Pokémon Champions VGC doubles, Regulation M-C, open team sheets, on the Pokémon Showdown ladder. Its own doubles simulator (MEDICHAM) is the foundation; a per-turn search and solver plays on it. Every published figure lives in the white paper; this file carries none.

Keywords: Pokémon, competitive Pokémon, VGC, Pokémon Showdown, game AI, machine learning, damage calculator, win probability, metagame analysis

## Start here

- [Live app](https://willhoop.github.io/abra/app/): ABRA WORLD, the site that renders what the artifacts say
- [White paper](https://github.com/willhoop/abra/blob/main/docs/ABRA-whitepaper.md): the results, the math and the sources; the one home for every figure
- [Plain-English deck](https://github.com/willhoop/abra/blob/main/docs/ABRA-deck-plain-english.md): the same story for a non-specialist
- [Technical documentation](https://github.com/willhoop/abra/blob/main/docs/ABRA-technical-docs.md): install, run and maintain
- [Source](https://github.com/willhoop/abra): the GitHub repository

## Entry points in code

- [engine/medicham_api.js](https://github.com/willhoop/abra/blob/main/engine/medicham_api.js): the simulator's solver API (clone, legal actions, step, playouts)
- [engine/status.js](https://github.com/willhoop/abra/blob/main/engine/status.js): prints the project's current state, each figure with its source artifact
